name: Status Mark
description: A status glyph with five states — pending, running, done, failed, and cancelled — whose ring spins and finally lands on a check or a cross.
interactionNotes: The component takes no input and is governed by `status`. In `pending` it shows eight static dashes; in `running`, if you pass `progress` the arc fills to that ratio, and otherwise a short arc travels around the ring. `done` draws the check, softly fills the circle, and strikes through the label; `failed` and `cancelled` draw a cross, and the cancelled label gets struck through.

props.name: status
props.description: The current state; each of the five states has its own Persian text.

props.name: progress
props.description: Only meaningful in `running`; 0 to 1 or 0 to 100 (values above 1 are read as a percentage).

props.name: label
props.description: The label next to the glyph; if omitted, only the glyph is shown.

props.name: color
props.description: The primary color of the ring and the marks.

props.name: doneColor
props.description: The color of the completion check.

props.name: errorColor
props.description: The color of the cross for failure and cancellation.

props.name: size
props.description: The glyph's edge length, in pixels; the gap between the glyph and the text is half of this.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke thickness of the ring and the marks.

props.name: dashes
props.description: The number of dashes in the idle state.

props.name: spinDuration
props.description: Duration of one indeterminate rotation, in milliseconds.

props.name: arcLength
props.description: Arc length in indeterminate mode, as a fraction of the circumference (0 to 1).

props.name: drawDuration
props.description: Duration of the check or cross being drawn, in milliseconds.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Intensity of the circle fill on completion.

props.name: strike
props.description: Strike-through of the label in `done` and `cancelled`.

props.name: strikeDelay
props.description: Delay of the strike-through, in milliseconds.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style; it layers onto the component's variables.

tips: `progress` accepts two scales: a 0-to-1 ratio (as in the default) and a 0-to-100 percentage. If your own form holds a rounded percentage, pass the 0-to-100 value — it normalizes it for you.

For a task list, give a stable label (such as "build output") rather than the status name: the status text is included automatically in the accessible name, and repeating it makes the screen reader say "done, done".
The glyph is the first child of the root flex, so under `dir="rtl"` it sits on the right by itself and the text on the left — no new `order` or `flex-direction` is needed.
With `prefers-reduced-motion`, the spin and draw are removed and the marks go straight to their final position; the state is still readable from the color and label.
